<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="FSO Interaction Record Page">75078bb2cfc2835009d5b6734d851cfc</macroponent><name>secondary_items/items</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Wrap up timer"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
 * @param {params} params
 * @param {api} params.api
 * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
 */
function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    const timerLabel = api.data.wrap_up.timerLabel;
    const timerColor = api.data.wrap_up.timerColor;
    const timeLeftInSecond = api.data.wrap_up.timeLeftInSecond;
    var secondaryItems = api.data.ribbonCtrl.secondaryItemsHeader;
    if (!api.data.wrap_up || api.data.wrap_up.enabledCodes || !api.data.wrap_up.showTimer || !timerLabel || timeLeftInSecond <= 0)
        return secondaryItems;

    var highlightedTimer = {
        "label": helpers.translateSync("Wrap up timer"),
        "value": {
            "label": timerLabel,
            "status": timerColor,
            "type": "highlighted-value"
        }
    };
    return secondaryItems ? [...secondaryItems, highlightedTimer] : [highlightedTimer];
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-17 02:50:45</sys_created_on><sys_id>0a074fb2cfc2835009d5b6734d851ca2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>secondary_items/items</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit" source="x_snc_pab_ee_tkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_0a074fb2cfc2835009d5b6734d851ca2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-17 02:50:45</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
